findings.observation: n_sma/n_rsi/n_atr index past the end for inputs shorter than their window and n_stdev silently returns zeros; new_day[0] is forced True
findings.handling: fail fast, or return a valid no-signal warmup; never crash and never emit a silent zero
findings.reproducer: a 10-row frame with SMA(50) raises IndexError

findings.observation: open_p is passed into the core but never read; the only output is a position state array
findings.handling: the position array is an intent, not a fill; SL/TP correctness cannot be claimed from it
findings.reproducer: replacing the entire open series after entry leaves pos unchanged

findings.observation: the time stop is evaluated before the price stop and the take profit, although the time condition is a boundary event rather than an intrabar price event
findings.handling: a frozen event sequence: resting protection at price phases, time stop submitted at the close or the next phase
findings.reproducer: a bar that hits the stop AND satisfies the time stop exits as a time stop

findings.observation: the dynamic VWAP exit compares the same bar's high/low against that bar's completed VWAP
findings.handling: either a resting order at the previously observed VWAP, or a close decision with a next-open market exit; a full-bar VWAP is never treated as known at the open
findings.reproducer: the VWAP used at bar t depends on bar t's own volume

findings.observation: entry is assumed at the close and the stop/target are derived from that assumed price
findings.handling: next-open entry, levels from the actual fill and the ATR available at the decision
findings.reproducer: a gap between close[t] and open[t+1] moves every level

findings.observation: the HTF EMA is resampled, shifted by one and merged backward; availability then depends on the resample label convention and a trailing ffill
findings.handling: closed-HTF prefix fixtures and an available_at join, not a label timestamp join
findings.reproducer: a right-labelled resample makes the shift(1) correct; a left-labelled one does not

findings.observation: the module-level default merges the tete preset, annotated 5m VN30F1M, with base
findings.handling: never run the default; only an explicit config for the five crypto symbols
findings.reproducer: params == {**tete, **base} at import time

findings.observation: uses np.* throughout but only imports njit from numba; the module cannot be imported
findings.handling: add the import in the lab copy only; the original digest is untouched
findings.reproducer: static: undefined global np@L8; dynamic: NameError on import

findings.observation: the variable called ATR is max(close_diff, |close_diff|) = |close-to-close move|; it never reads high/low, and atr[14] = mean(tr[1:15]) is unguarded for short input
findings.handling: legacy keeps close_move_rma14; a true-range ATR is a separate versioned variant
findings.reproducer: constant closes with a wide high/low range yield 0.0; a 10-row input raises IndexError

findings.observation: equity accumulates realized PnL and fees only; an open position is never marked to market
findings.handling: never used as the equity curve or an objective; the engine ledger is authoritative
findings.reproducer: 10 units entered at 100 with last close 110 reports equity 10000 while wallet+UPnL is 10100

findings.observation: the if/elif chain handles at most one TP stage per bar, and the final TP branch is only reachable once tp1_done and tp2_done are both True
findings.handling: the canonical ladder is explicit and ordered; the stage-lock chain is a labelled legacy reproduction
findings.reproducer: a bar spanning TP1, TP2 and the final TP fills only TP1: units 10 -> 5

findings.observation: entry is booked at the same close that produced the signal; no open, latency or gap model
findings.handling: close decision, next-open fill; SL/TP levels derive from the actual fill price
findings.reproducer: the fill price equals close[t] regardless of the next bar's open

findings.observation: TP2 quantity is a percentage of the REMAINING units, not of the entry quantity
findings.handling: locked as fraction_of_remaining; never silently re-based to the original quantity
findings.reproducer: tp1 55% then tp2 65% of the remainder leaves 0.1575 of the entry, not 0.30 (units 10 -> 1.575)

findings.observation: 4 of the 6 supplied presets violate tp1 < tp2 < final
findings.handling: rejected for the canonical simultaneous ladder; the raw order is kept, never silently sorted

findings.observation: a comment asserts the next open equals the current close; the core never receives open
findings.handling: the actual fill comes from the engine; no equality assumption
findings.reproducer: the core signature has no open argument

findings.observation: pos_weight[t] is the position carried INTO bar t, while exit_type/exit_price for the same index are intrabar events of bar t
findings.handling: a pre-bar weight and a post-close target are separate fields; never summed or lagged twice
findings.reproducer: an exit at bar t leaves pos_weight[t] == 1 with exit_type[t] == 1

findings.observation: stop and target prices are closed inside the alpha with no gap, slippage or fill model
findings.handling: levels are intents; the fill price is the engine's decision
findings.reproducer: exit_price is set to buySL exactly, whatever the bar's open was

findings.observation: 4 of the 13 presets have min_length > max_length
findings.handling: raw references retained; the canonical adapter rejects them and never silently swaps

findings.observation: time_ms, volume and double_up are accepted but never read, and sl_mult appears in all 13 presets while the code never reads it
findings.handling: dropped from the active search space and flagged deprecated; never re-implemented under the old name
findings.reproducer: AST: no Load of time_ms/volume/double_up; sl_mult is absent from the parameter schema

findings.observation: mintick is hardcoded to 0.0001 for every instrument, and the pip buffer is 10x that
findings.handling: use instrument tick metadata; the pip-buffer semantics are versioned
findings.reproducer: a 5-pip buffer is 0.005 absolute regardless of the symbol's real tick size

findings.observation: the RSI seed returns 50 when avg_gain and avg_loss are both zero, but every later bar returns 100 whenever avg_loss is zero, even with avg_gain zero
findings.handling: canonical keeps flat=50 at the seed; making the recursion consistent is an indicator repair applied before any A/B
findings.reproducer: a flat series seeds 50 then reports 100 on the next bar

findings.observation: every kernel is njit(fastmath=True) and the dynamic helpers clamp negative indices to 0, padding the start of the series with repeated values
findings.handling: the reference oracle runs fastmath=False; warmup convergence is explicit
findings.reproducer: _xhma_at_t at t=0 averages src[0] repeated

findings.observation: the epoch conversion divides by 10**6, assuming nanosecond index values
findings.handling: convert timezone and unit explicitly; time_ms is unused so no timestamp correctness is claimed
findings.reproducer: a second-resolution index would be scaled wrongly

unused_knobs.note: an unused argument or an unread preset key must be dropped from the active search space and flagged deprecated, never re-implemented under the old name (guide HM-05)

findings.observation: the indicator is chosen by 'novolumedata or volume missing' but the method is dispatched on novolumedata alone, so a missing volume column calls money_flow_index on an RSIIndicator
findings.handling: resolve use_rsi once; the main crypto path requires volume and the fallback is explicit
findings.reproducer: a frame with no volume column and novolumedata=False raises AttributeError

findings.observation: coeff is cast with int(), so fractional search values collapse onto integers
findings.handling: search coeff as an integer; never advertise fractional trials as distinct
findings.reproducer: coeff 4.0 and 4.9 both become 4

findings.observation: the cross test compares trend[t] against trend[t-2] and trend[t-1] against trend[t-2], which is not the conventional crossover(trend, trend.shift(2))
findings.handling: the source convention is kept in canonical_v1; a standard crossover is an optional research revision, never a silent fix
findings.reproducer: a conventional crossover compares trend[t-1] against trend[t-3]

findings.observation: approved (shifted) signals are computed but execution consumes the unapproved ones
findings.handling: declare the decision timestamp and the intent timing once; never double-shift
findings.reproducer: buy_signal_approved is never referenced after being assigned

findings.observation: position takes only 0 or 2; the short branch sets 0, so the strategy is long-flat
findings.handling: canonical stays long-flat; shorting is never enabled to improve a result
findings.reproducer: the observed position path is [0, 2, 0, 0, 2] with no negative value

findings.observation: trend is seeded at 0.0, so the FIRST bar whose condition is true ratchets it from 0 up to a real price level; that jump always satisfies (trend > trend[-2]) and (trend[-1] <= trend[-2]), manufacturing a buy_signal that carries no information
findings.handling: warmup is not ready until the trend has been initialised and the 2-bar comparison window is clear of the seed; found by the lab, not listed in the guide
findings.reproducer: on any series the first condition-true bar emits buy_signal=True regardless of price action

findings.observation: average_true_range() and the condition indicator are recomputed inside the loop, and the bars-since counters are rebuilt row by row
findings.handling: may be vectorised in the lab AFTER output parity; the reset rules do not change
findings.reproducer: the indicator is recomputed on every one of n iterations
